text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads-up: HelioSolve agreed to be our Q2 customer spotlight. Need interview, quote sign-off, legal opt-in, and a webinar mention. Can we map responsibilities + timeline?
Priya (Content): Excited. I'll draft the narrative (hero stat + 3 soundbites) once we lock the metric language.
Diego (PMM): Suggest positioning around reliability + unit-cost savings rather than raw throughput. Short hero: 'Reduced tail latency by 45% while lowering inference cost by 30%.' We'll include a parenthetical date for tests.
Sasha (CSM): HelioSolve will provide an infra owner and a product lead for the interview. They prefer 45min so we can capture a technical snippet and an exec quote.
Mei (Legal): Reminder: opt-in form + logo usage clause required. If we publish numbers, send the perf snapshot and the evaluation method to legal@redwood.
Ava (Marketing): Good call. @Jordan (Sales) 1: routing after webinar?
Jordan (Sales): Route registrants -> tag 'helio-launch' -> attended >= 40% -> send to AE queue 'launch-insights'. Also capture company size field in CTA.
Priya (Content): Draft interview guide below 1:```
- Can you describe the user flow you serve with the model?
- What were the biggest pain points before Redwood?
- Can you share one measurable outcome from the change? (pct/x-fold)
- A short line on how ops/dev velocity changed?
```
Elena (HelioSolve): Thanks everyone. We can do Tue or Wed next week 11am PT. We'll share a small metrics extract ahead of time.
calendar-bot: Event created: "HelioSolve customer interview" Tue 11:00 - attendees: Ava, Priya, Sasha, Elena.
Diego (PMM): For the benchmark appendix I'll need batch sizes, sequence length distribution, and whether KV-cache was warm. Eng can redact any PII.
Sasha (CSM): I'll upload their internal metrics spreadsheet to the private drive and tag Mei for legal review.
Mei (Legal): Once I get the spreadsheet and method note I'll aim to reply within 24 hours. If wording needs softening we'll convert to relative phrasing.
Ava (Marketing): Proposed timeline: interview Tue, draft quote Wed, legal OK Thu, assets staged next Tue, webinar tie-in in the publish week. Any objections?
Jordan (Sales): Works. Make sure the webinar CTA captures product role so I can prioritize follow-ups.
Priya (Content): Asset list: hero stat + one-liner quote, 2 social teasers, hero graphic (with stat callout), raw transcript, 3 audio soundbites. Also a short benchmark appendix PDF.
Elena (HelioSolve): One note: we'd like a 3-business-day internal review window and a one-week embargo after that. Also we'll only approve one dashboard screenshot (watermarked).
Ava (Marketing): Noted. We'll include embargo and screenshot constraints in the opt-in.
Diego (PMM): I'll attach a brief methods blurb to the appendix: A/B vs baseline, test date (Apr 2026), average seq len, p50/p95/p99 latency.
Sasha (CSM): Interview invites sent. Elena confirmed Tue 11am.
calendar-bot: Reminder set: 24h before meeting.
Mei (Legal): Quick reminder about trademarks: if we use their logo, ensure the trademark clause is signed. Also flag any regulatory language from HelioSolve's side.
Ava (Marketing): OK closing loop: Priya drafts narrative, Diego preps bench notes, Sasha uploads metrics, Mei reviews legal, Jordan sets lead routing. Interview Tue 11am. I'll post the draft announcement for feedback after interview. If anything slips call it out here.
